item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 15 #SLPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 15 #SLPRSD
Issued at 05:00 AM 02 October 2026

Moderate to occasionally heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Romblon(Romblon, SanAgustin, SantaMaria, Odiongan, SanAndres, Calatrava, Alcantara, SantaFe, Looc, Ferrol, SanJose, Magdiwang, Cajidiocan), #OrientalMindoro(Pola and Naujan) within the next 1 to 2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #OrientalMindoro(Roxas, Bongabong, Bansud, Gloria, Pinamalayan, Socorro, Victoria) and #Romblon(SanFernando) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
